title: Reduce safe app navigation without claiming live authority or global pause
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Implement only the owned source and tests, using the exact pinned API section in PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS. No imports from unmerged A/B modules, no manifests/barrels/App.tsx/shared task metadata edits and no new dependencies. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. Use existing deterministic engine RNG only where the contract permits. Never turn a trusted verifier input into a claim of cryptographic verification. Unspecified rules remain explicit named decision-required results; no worker invents policies. Preserve existing T01–T10 API/tests. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests, then node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full. Return a handoff with paths, API, actual checks, benchmark receipt references and limitations. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, deployment, credential access, task-issue mutation or budget changes. Implement localNavigation exactly as frozen in section B099 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Frozen route transitions: launch+enter→profile; profile+profile-confirm→home; home+play-solo→solo-setup; home+play-multiplayer→directory; directory+joined-lobby→lobby; solo-setup/lobby+authority-match-start→match; match+authority-match-end→results; lobby/match/results+leave-confirmed→home(clearPrivateView true). results+return-after-match→solo-setup in Solo or lobby in multiplayer, clearing private view. results+again-after-match follows the same return route and clear, but sets requestFreshMatch:true so the adapter requests a fresh authority session from that setup/lobby; it never routes straight to match or fabricates a winner. requestFreshMatch is false for every other accepted transition. back: profile→launch,solo-setup/directory→home; other combinations forbidden. No route action fabricates gameplay, globally pauses online state or skips explicit leave confirmation.
acceptance: Every declared source/event transition reaches its exact destination; results return to the correct mode-specific setup/lobby and clear private cache, while Again additionally requests fresh authority without entering match directly.
Plain back cannot leave live match/lobby/results or bypass leave confirmation, and user play does not fabricate authority-match-start.
All undeclared pairs reject without route mutation; no hidden localStorage/session or game-clock access is used.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.

Scoped lint, typecheck and meaningful tests pass, followed by node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; handoff records actual outcomes and receipt references without claiming App/provider integration.
